goodToKnow: Der Religionsunterricht is religious education. Under Article 7 of the Grundgesetz, it's a regular school subject in most states, taught along confessional lines (katholisch, evangelisch, increasingly islamisch) in cooperation with religious communities. Pupils can opt out and usually take Ethik or Philosophie instead. Berlin and Brandenburg have special rules. Der Unterricht means lessons. It has no plural.
